page: Microsoft Azure D32alds_v6 is an x86_64 server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor operating at 3.7 GHz. Built on Microsoft Hyper-V, the system provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory footprint comprises 64.0 GB of RAM, resulting in a 2.0 GB allocation per vCPU. Hardware features include an integrated 1890 GB NVMe solid-state drive for low-latency local storage, alongside support for Premium Storage tiers. Advanced CPU instructions include AVX-512 with VNNI and BF16 extensions, as well as hardware-accelerated cryptographic instructions such as AES, VAES, and SHA-NI.

Benchmark measurements show solid processing capability, particularly in single-core and cryptographic execution. The instance recorded a Geekbench single-core score of 2099.0 and a multi-core score of 17923.0, both reaching the top quartile. Stress-ng single-core processing also placed in the top quartile at 3081.05, while Passmark CPU encryption scored 38565.36. Memory subsystem performance is characterized by an uncached large-block read speed of 80.53 GB/sec and a Passmark memory score of 2756.72. Lightweight language model evaluation revealed high throughput, reaching 344.97 tokens per second for text generation on a 135M model.

The compact 1:2 memory-to-core ratio maximizes compute density while minimizing unnecessary memory overhead, offering a cost-efficient architecture for CPU-bound tasks. The presence of direct NVMe storage provides rapid scratch space, though memory limitations make it less suitable for massive in-memory datasets or 70B parameter language model generation. The server is well positioned for software build systems, static web application serving, batch data transformation, and distributed transactional database instances.
description: Microsoft Azure D32alds_v6 is a compute-oriented virtual server featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs and 64.0 GB of RAM, driven by an AMD EPYC 9V74 processor clocked at 3.7 GHz. Configured with 16 physical cores on the x86_64 architecture, it incorporates a local 1890 GB NVMe SSD and provides architectural support for AVX-512 and cryptographic accelerators. Benchmarks highlight strong CPU performance, recording a Geekbench single-core score of 2099.0, a multi-core score of 17923.0, and top-tier text generation throughput on small language models. The 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU allocation yields strong compute efficiency for workloads that do not demand extensive memory capacity. With high-speed local disk caching and solid multi-threaded performance, this server is suitable for continuous integration pipelines, batch data transformations, static web workloads, and database operations.
